fields.description: Issue dated March 24, 1928 (Vol. 5, no. 10), published by Miami Life, Inc., and edited by WEN R. PHILLIPS. Prominent coverage includes an editorial on a sensational police investigation and grand jury actions involving Chief of Police H. Leslie Quigg, including discussion of alleged jail torture and criticism of city commissioners. The issue also covers city commission debate over hiring an outside band versus employing local musicians for municipal concerts, along with local political campaign notes and election-related items. Additional pieces address public health concerns (mattress sterilization and sanitation), local infrastructure and beautification topics, entertainment listings, sports/fight promotion at Coral Gables, legal notices, and advertisements.
